en: 2. Khandha Yamaka 2.2 Pavattivāra 2.2.1.
Uppādavāra (The Chapter on Arising)
2.2.1.1 Present Section (Paccuppannavāra) 2.2.1.1.1 Positive Person (Anulomapuggala) For whom the aggregate of form arises,
does the aggregate of feeling arise for that person?
For those beings reborn among the non-percipient beings (*asaññasatta*), the aggregate of form (*rūpakkhandha*) arises, but the aggregate of feeling (*vedanākkhandha*) does not arise for them.
For those being reborn in the five-aggregate realm (*pañcavokāra*), both the aggregate of form and the aggregate of feeling arise.
Or conversely, for whomsoever the aggregate of feeling arises, does the aggregate of form arise for them?

For those being reborn in the formless realm (arūpa), the aggregate of feeling arises, but the aggregate of form does not arise for them. For those being reborn in the five-aggregate realm (pañcavokāra), both the aggregate of feeling and the aggregate of form arise.
2.2.1.1.2. Positive Plane (Anuloma-okāsa):
Where the aggregate of form arises, does the aggregate of feeling arise there?

In the case of non-percipient beings (*asaññasatta*), the aggregate of form (*rūpakkhandha*) arises there, but the aggregate of feeling (*vedanākkhandha*) does not arise there. In the five-aggregate realm (*pañcavokāra*), both the aggregate of form and the aggregate of feeling arise there.
Or, conversely, where the aggregate of feeling arises, does the aggregate of form arise there?

In the immaterial realm (*arūpa*), the aggregate of feeling arises there, but the aggregate of form does not arise there. In the five-aggregate realm, both the aggregate of feeling and the aggregate of form arise there.
2.2.1.1.3. Positive Person-Space (Anuloma-Puggalokāsa) For whom, where the aggregate of form (rūpakkhandha) arises, does the aggregate of feeling (vedanākkhandha) arise there for them?
For those beings at the moment of rebirth among non-percipient beings (asaññasatta), the aggregate of form arises there, but the aggregate of feeling does not arise there for them.
The aggregate of feeling arises. For those being reborn in the five-aggregate realm, both the aggregate of form and the aggregate of feeling arise there.
Or conversely, for whomsoever the aggregate of feeling arises in a certain place, does the aggregate of form also arise for them there?
For those being reborn in the formless realm, the aggregate of feeling arises there, but the aggregate of form does not arise there for them.
For those being reborn in the five-aggregate realm, both the aggregate of feeling and the aggregate of form arise there.
2.2.1.1.4. Negative Person (Paccanīka-puggala)
For whom the aggregate of form does not arise, for that person does the aggregate of feeling not arise?

For those being reborn in the formless realm, the aggregate of form does not arise, but it is not the case that the aggregate of feeling does not arise for them. For all those passing away, neither the aggregate of form nor the aggregate of feeling arises.
Or conversely, for whom the aggregate of feeling does not arise, for that person does the aggregate of form not arise?

For those being reborn among the non-percipient beings (*asaññasatta*), the aggregate of feeling (*vedanākkhandha*) does not arise; yet, for them, the aggregate of form (*rūpakkhandha*) does not fail to arise. For all those passing away, neither the aggregate of feeling nor the aggregate of form arises.
2.2.1.1.5. Negative Spatial Analysis (*Paccanīka-okāsa*):
Where the aggregate of form does not arise, does the aggregate of feeling not arise there? It does arise.
Or again, where the aggregate of feeling does not arise, does the aggregate of form not arise there? It does arise.
2.2.1.1.6. Negative Person-Space:
For whom, wherever the aggregate of form does not arise, for that person does the aggregate of feeling not arise there?
For those being reborn in the formless realm (*arūpa*), the aggregate of form (*rūpakkhandha*) does not arise there;

yet, for them, the aggregate of feeling (*vedanākkhandha*) does not fail to arise there. For all those passing away, neither the aggregate of form nor the aggregate of feeling arises there. Or conversely:
for whomsoever the aggregate of feeling does not arise in a certain place, does the aggregate of form also not arise for them there?
For those beings reborn among the non-percipient beings, the aggregate of feeling does not arise there,
yet it is not the case that the aggregate of form does not arise for them there. For all those passing away, neither the aggregate of feeling nor the aggregate of form arises there.
2.2.1.2. Chapter on the Past (Atītavāra) 2.2.1.2.1.
Positive Person (Anulomapuggala) For whom the aggregate of form (rūpakkhandha) had arisen, had the aggregate of feeling (vedanākkhandha) arisen for that person? Yes, it had.
Or again, for whomsoever the aggregate of feeling had arisen, had the aggregate of form arisen for him? Yes.
2.2.1.2.2. Positive Plane:
Wherever the aggregate of form had arisen, had the aggregate of feeling arisen there?

In the case of non-percipient beings, the aggregate of form had arisen there, but the aggregate of feeling had not arisen there. In the five-aggregate realm, both the aggregate of form and the aggregate of feeling had arisen there.
Or, conversely, where the aggregate of feeling had arisen, had the aggregate of form arisen there?

In the immaterial realm, the aggregate of feeling had arisen there, but the aggregate of form had not arisen there. In the five-aggregate realm, both the aggregate of feeling and the aggregate of form had arisen there.
2.2.1.2.3. Positive Person-Space (Anuloma-Puggalokāsa) For whom, and in what place, did the aggregate of form arise, for that same person and in that same place did the aggregate of feeling arise?
In the case of non-percipient beings, the aggregate of form arose for them there, but the aggregate of feeling did not arise for them there.
[It] arose. For those belonging to the five-aggregate realm, both the aggregate of form and the aggregate of feeling arose there.
Or, for whomsoever the aggregate of feeling arose there, did the aggregate of form arise for them there?
For those who are non-material (arūpa), the aggregate of feeling arose there, but the aggregate of form did not arise for them there.
[It] arose. For those belonging to the five-aggregate realm, both the aggregate of feeling and the aggregate of form arose there.
2.2.1.2.4. Negative Person (Paccanīka-puggala):
For whom the aggregate of form did not arise, for that person did the aggregate of feeling not arise? None.
Or conversely, for whom the aggregate of feeling had not arisen, had the aggregate of form not arisen for them? None.
2.2.1.2.5. Negative Plane:
Where the aggregate of form had not arisen, had the aggregate of feeling not arisen there? It had arisen.
Or, where the aggregate of feeling had not arisen, had the aggregate of form not arisen there? It had arisen.
2.2.1.2.6. Negative Person-Space:
For whom, wherever the aggregate of form had not arisen, for that person had the aggregate of feeling not arisen there?
For those immaterial beings, the aggregate of form did not arise there;
yet it is not the case that for them the aggregate of feeling did not arise there. For those pure-abode beings, neither the aggregate of form nor the aggregate of feeling arose there.
Or else, for whomsoever the aggregate of feeling did not arise in a certain place, did the aggregate of form not also arise there for him?
For those non-percipient beings, the aggregate of feeling had not arisen there; yet it is not the case that the aggregate of form had not arisen there for them.
For those pure-abode beings, neither the aggregate of feeling nor the aggregate of form had arisen there.
2.2.1.3. Chapter on the Future (Anāgatavāra)
2.2.1.3.1. Positive Person (Anulomapuggala) For whom the aggregate of form (rūpakkhandha) will arise, for that person will the aggregate of feeling (vedanākkhandha) arise? Yes.
Or rather, for whom the aggregate of feeling will arise, for that person will the aggregate of form arise? Yes.
For those who, having been reborn in the formless realm, will attain final nibbāna there, the aggregate of feeling will arise, but the aggregate of form will not arise for them.
For others, both the aggregate of feeling and the aggregate of form will arise.
2.2.1.3.2. Positive Plane Analysis (Anuloma-okāsa)
Where the aggregate of form will arise, will the aggregate of feeling also arise there?

In the case of non-percipient beings, the aggregate of form will arise there, but the aggregate of feeling will not arise there. In the five-aggregate realm, both the aggregate of form and the aggregate of feeling will arise.
Or conversely, where the aggregate of feeling will arise, will the aggregate of form also arise there?

In the formless realm (*arūpa*), the aggregate of feeling (*vedanā-khandha*) will arise there, but the aggregate of form (*rūpa-khandha*) will not arise there. In the five-aggregate realm (*pañcavokāra*), both the aggregate of feeling and the aggregate of form will arise there.
2.2.1.3.3. Positive Correlation of Person and Plane (*Anuloma-puggalokāsa*):
For whomsoever the aggregate of form will arise in a certain plane, will the aggregate of feeling also arise for that person in that same plane?
For those non-percipient beings, the aggregate of form will arise there, but the aggregate of feeling will not arise for them there.
For those of the five-aggregate realm, both the aggregate of form and the aggregate of feeling will arise there.
Or conversely, for whomsoever the aggregate of feeling will arise there, will the aggregate of form also arise for them there?
For those immaterial beings, the aggregate of feeling will arise there, but the aggregate of form will not arise there for them.
For those of the five-aggregate realm, both the aggregate of feeling and the aggregate of form will arise there.
2.2.1.3.4. Negative Person (Paccanīka-puggala)
For whom the aggregate of form will not arise, for them the aggregate of feeling will not arise?

For those who, having been reborn in the formless realm, will attain final Nibbāna there, the aggregate of form will not arise, but it is not the case that the aggregate of feeling will not arise for them.
For those in their final existence, neither the aggregate of form nor [the aggregate of feeling] will arise.
The aggregate of feeling will not arise.
Or, for whomsoever the aggregate of feeling will not arise, will the aggregate of form not arise for them? Yes.
2.2.1.3.5. Negative Plane (Paccanīka-Okāsa).
Where the aggregate of form will not arise, will the aggregate of feeling not arise there? It will arise.
Or, where the aggregate of feeling will not arise, will the aggregate of form not arise there? It will arise.
2.2.1.3.6. Negative Person-Space Analysis.
For whom the aggregate of form will not arise in a certain place, for them the aggregate of feeling will not arise in that place?
For non-percipient beings, the aggregate of form will not arise there, but the aggregate of feeling will not fail to arise for them there.
For those in their final existence, neither the aggregate of form nor the aggregate of feeling will arise there.
Or, for whomsoever the aggregate of feeling will not arise at a certain place, will the aggregate of form not arise for them there?
For non-percipient beings, the aggregate of feeling will not arise there, but the aggregate of form will not fail to arise for them there.
For those in their final existence, neither the aggregate of feeling nor the aggregate of form will arise there.
2.2.1.4. Chapter on the Present and the Past (Paccuppannātītavāra) 2.2.1.4.1.
Positive Person (Anulomapuggala) For whom the aggregate of form (rūpakkhandha) arises, for that person did the aggregate of feeling (vedanākkhandha) arise? Yes.
Or, for whomsoever the aggregate of feeling had arisen, does the aggregate of form arise for them?
For all those passing away and for those being reborn in the immaterial realm, the aggregate of feeling had arisen, but the aggregate of form does not arise for them.
For those being reborn in the five-aggregate realm and for those being reborn among the non-percipient beings...
For those [persons], the aggregate of feeling had arisen and the aggregate of form arises.
For whomsoever the aggregate of feeling arises, for that person had the aggregate of perception arisen? Yes.
Or rather, for whomsoever the aggregate of perception had arisen, for that person does the aggregate of feeling arise?
For all those passing away and for those being reborn among non-percipient beings, the aggregate of perception had arisen,
but the aggregate of feeling does not arise for them. For those being reborn in the four-aggregate or five-aggregate realms,
both the aggregate of perception and the aggregate of feeling have arisen.
2.2.1.4.2. Positive Section (Anuloma-okāsa) Where the aggregate of form arises, has the aggregate of feeling arisen there?

In the case of non-percipient beings, the aggregate of form arises there, but the aggregate of feeling has not arisen there. In the five-aggregate planes, both the aggregate of form and the aggregate of feeling have arisen there.
Or, where the aggregate of feeling (vedanā-khandha) had arisen, does the aggregate of form (rūpa-khandha) arise there?

In the immaterial realm (arūpa), the aggregate of feeling had arisen there, but the aggregate of form does not arise there. In the five-aggregate realm (pañcavokāra), the aggregate of feeling had arisen and the aggregate of form also arises there.
Where the aggregate of feeling arises, has the aggregate of perception (saññā-khandha) arisen there? Yes.
Or, where the aggregate of perception (saññākkhandha) had arisen, does the aggregate of feeling (vedanākkhandha) arise there? Yes.
2.2.1.4.3. Positive Person-Space:
For whom, wherever the aggregate of form (rūpakkhandha) arises, has the aggregate of feeling arisen there for that person?
For those reborn in the Pure Abodes and for those reborn among the non-percipient beings,
the aggregate of form arises there, but the aggregate of feeling has not arisen there for them. For others who are reborn in the five-aggregate realm,
both the aggregate of form and the aggregate of feeling have arisen there.
Or again, for whomsoever the aggregate of feeling had arisen at a certain place, does the aggregate of form arise for them there?
For those passing away from the five-aggregate plane and for those non-percipient beings, the aggregate of feeling had arisen there, but the aggregate of form does not arise for them there.
For those being reborn into the five-aggregate plane, the aggregate of feeling [arises] there...
And the aggregate of form has arisen.
For whomsoever, wherever, the aggregate of feeling arises, for that person there, had the aggregate of perception arisen?
For those beings being reborn in the Pure Abodes (suddhāvāsa), the aggregate of feeling arises there, but for them the aggregate of perception had not [previously] arisen there.

The perception aggregate had arisen. For those others who are being reborn in the four-aggregate or five-aggregate realms, both the feeling aggregate arises and the perception aggregate had arisen there.
Or else, for whomsoever the perception aggregate had arisen in a certain place, does the feeling aggregate arise there for that person?
For those passing away from the four-aggregate or five-aggregate states, the aggregate of perception had arisen there,
but the aggregate of feeling does not arise there for them. For those being reborn into the four-aggregate or five-aggregate states,
both the aggregate of perception and the aggregate of feeling have arisen there.
2.2.1.4.4. Negative Person (Paccanīka-puggala) For whom the aggregate of form (rūpakkhandha) does not arise, for that person did the aggregate of feeling (vedanākkhandha) not arise? It had arisen.
Or rather, for whom the aggregate of feeling had not arisen, for that person does the aggregate of form not arise? There is no such case.
For whom the aggregate of feeling does not arise, for that person did the aggregate of perception not arise? It had arisen.
Or else, for whom the aggregate of perception did not arise, for that person does the aggregate of feeling not arise? There is none.
2.2.1.4.5. Negative Plane (Paccanīka-okāsa).
Where the aggregate of form does not arise, has the aggregate of feeling not arisen there? It has arisen.
Or else, where the aggregate of feeling has not arisen, does the aggregate of form not arise there? It arises.
Where the aggregate of feeling does not arise, has the aggregate of perception not arisen there? Yes.
Or again: Where the aggregate of perception (saññākkhandha) has not arisen, does the aggregate of feeling (vedanākkhandha) not arise there? Yes.
2.2.1.4.6. Negative Person-Space (Paccanīka-Puggalokāsa):
For whom, where the aggregate of form (rūpakkhandha) does not arise, for that person does the aggregate of feeling not arise there?
For those passing away from the five-aggregate plane and for those non-percipient beings, the aggregate of form does not arise there,
yet the aggregate of feeling has not failed to have arisen there for them. For those attaining final nibbāna in the Pure Abodes and for those passing away from the non-percipient beings,
neither the aggregate of form nor the aggregate of feeling has arisen there.
Or conversely: for whomsoever the aggregate of feeling has not arisen at a certain place, does the aggregate of form not arise for them there?
For those who are being reborn in the Pure Abodes (suddhāvāsa) and for those who are being reborn among the non-percipient beings (asaññasatta), the aggregate of feeling has not arisen there;
yet, for them, the aggregate of form does not fail to arise there. [This is so] for those attaining final nibbāna in the Pure Abodes.
For those non-percipient beings passing away, the aggregate of feeling had not arisen there, and the aggregate of form does not arise there.
For whomsoever the aggregate of feeling does not arise at a certain place, for that person had the aggregate of perception not arisen there?

For those passing away from the four-constituent or five-constituent realms, the aggregate of feeling does not arise there; yet it is not the case that for them [the aggregate of perception had not arisen].

In that case, the aggregate of perception did not arise. For those who attain final nibbāna in the Pure Abodes (suddhāvāsa) and for non-percipient beings (asaññasatta), neither the aggregate of feeling nor the aggregate of perception arises there. Or conversely:
for whomsoever the aggregate of perception did not arise in a certain place, does the aggregate of feeling not arise for them in that same place?
For those being reborn in the Pure Abodes, the aggregate of perception has not arisen there,
yet the aggregate of feeling does not fail to arise for them there. For those attaining final Nibbāna in the Pure Abodes and for non-percipient beings,
neither the aggregate of perception nor the aggregate of feeling arises there.
2.2.1.5. Chapter on the Present and Future (Paccuppannānāgatavāra) 2.2.1.5.1.
Positive Person (Anulomapuggala) For whom the aggregate of form (rūpakkhandha) arises, will the aggregate of feeling (vedanākkhandha) arise for that person?
For those attaining rebirth in the five-aggregate realm who are destined for their final existence, the aggregate of form arises,

but the aggregate of feeling will not arise for them. For others attaining rebirth in the five-aggregate realm and for those attaining rebirth among the non-percipient beings, both the aggregate of form and the aggregate of feeling will arise.
Or again, for whom the aggregate of feeling will arise, does the aggregate of form arise for them?
For all those passing away and for those being reborn in the immaterial plane, the aggregate of feeling will arise, but the aggregate of form does not arise for them.
For those being reborn in the five-aggregate plane and for those being reborn among the non-percipient beings...
For those persons, the aggregate of feeling will arise and the aggregate of form is arising. For whom the aggregate of feeling arises, will the aggregate of perception arise for them?
For those entering their final existence at rebirth, the aggregate of feeling arises, but the aggregate of perception does not arise for them.
It will arise. For those others who are being reborn in the four-aggregate or five-aggregate realms, both the feeling aggregate arises and the perception aggregate will arise.
Or else, for whomsoever the perception aggregate will arise, does the feeling aggregate arise for them?
For all those passing away and for those being reborn among the non-percipient beings, the aggregate of perception will arise,
but the aggregate of feeling does not arise for them. For those being reborn in the four-aggregate or five-aggregate realms,
both the aggregate of perception and the aggregate of feeling will arise.
2.2.1.5.2. Positive Section (Anuloma-okāsa) Where the aggregate of form arises, will the aggregate of feeling arise there?

In the case of non-percipient beings, the aggregate of form arises there, but the aggregate of feeling will not arise there. In the five-aggregate realm, both the aggregate of form and the aggregate of feeling arise there.
Or again: Wherever the aggregate of feeling will arise, does the aggregate of form arise there?

In the immaterial realm (arūpa), the aggregate of feeling will arise there, but the aggregate of form does not arise there. In the five-aggregate plane (pañcavokāra), both the aggregate of feeling will arise and the aggregate of form arises.
Wherever the aggregate of feeling arises, will the aggregate of perception arise there? Yes.
Or, where the aggregate of perception will arise, does the aggregate of feeling arise there? Yes.
2.2.1.5.3. Positive Person-Space:
For whom, wherever the aggregate of form arises, will the aggregate of feeling arise there for that person?
For those destined for their final existence who are being reborn in the five-aggregate realm, and for those being reborn among the non-percipient beings,
the aggregate of form arises there, but the aggregate of feeling will not arise for them there.
For others who are being reborn in the five-aggregate realm, both the aggregate of form and the aggregate of feeling arise there.
Or alternatively: for whomsoever the aggregate of feeling will arise at a certain place, does the aggregate of form arise for them there?
For those passing away from the five-aggregate realm and for those non-percipient beings, the aggregate of feeling will arise there, but the aggregate of form does not arise for them there.
For those being reborn into the five-aggregate realm, the aggregate of feeling [arises there].
And the aggregate of form will arise.
For whom, where the aggregate of feeling arises, will the aggregate of perception arise there for them?
For those entering the womb as final-existence beings, the aggregate of feeling arises there, but for them [the aggregate of perception] does not [arise].

In that case, the aggregate of perception will arise. For those who are being reborn in the four-aggregate or five-aggregate realms, both the aggregate of feeling and the aggregate of perception arise there. Or conversely:
for whomsoever the aggregate of perception will arise in a certain place, does the aggregate of feeling arise for them there?
For those passing away from the four-constituent or five-constituent realms, the aggregate of perception will arise there,
but the aggregate of feeling does not arise there for them. For those being reborn into the four-constituent or five-constituent realms,
both the aggregate of perception and the aggregate of feeling will arise there.
2.2.1.5.4. Negative Person (Paccanīka-puggala) For whom the aggregate of form does not arise, for that person will the aggregate of feeling not arise?

For all those who are passing away and for those being reborn in the immaterial realm, the aggregate of form does not arise; yet it is not the case that for them [the aggregate of feeling will not arise].

The aggregate of feeling will not arise. For those attaining final nibbāna in the five-aggregate plane and for those in their last existence in the formless plane, neither the aggregate of material form nor the aggregate of feeling will arise.
Or conversely, for whomsoever the aggregate of feeling will not arise, does the aggregate of material form not arise for them?
For those final-existence beings who are being reborn in the five-aggregate realm, the aggregate of feeling will not arise,
but the aggregate of form does not fail to arise for them. For those attaining final nibbāna in the five-aggregate realm and for those final-existence beings in the immaterial realm,
neither the aggregate of feeling nor the aggregate of form will arise.
For whom the aggregate of feeling does not arise, will the aggregate of perception not arise for them?

For all those passing away and for those being reborn among non-percipient beings, the aggregate of feeling does not arise, yet the aggregate of perception will not fail to arise for them. For those attaining final Nibbāna, the aggregate of feeling...
The aggregate of perception does not arise and will not arise.
Or, for whom the aggregate of perception will not arise, does the aggregate of feeling not arise for them?
For those entering the womb as beings in their final existence, the aggregate of perception will not arise, but it is not the case that the aggregate of feeling does not arise for them.
The aggregate of feeling does not arise. For those attaining final Nibbāna, both the aggregate of perception will not arise and the aggregate of feeling does not arise.
2.2.1.5.5. Negative Spatial Relation:
Where the aggregate of form does not arise, will the aggregate of feeling not arise there? It will arise.
Or, where the aggregate of feeling will not arise, does the aggregate of form not arise there? It does arise.
Where the aggregate of feeling does not arise, will the aggregate of perception not arise there? Yes.
Or, where the aggregate of perception will not arise, does the aggregate of feeling not arise there? Yes.
2.2.1.5.6. Negative Person-Space (Paccanīka-Puggalokāsa) For whom, where the aggregate of form (rūpakkhandha) does not arise, will the aggregate of feeling (vedanākkhandha) not arise there for them?

For those passing away from the five-aggregate plane (pañcavokāra) and for those non-percipient beings (arūpa), the aggregate of form does not arise there; yet it is not the case that the aggregate of feeling will not arise for them there.

In that case, the feeling aggregate will not arise. For those attaining final Nibbāna in the five-aggregate realm, for those in their final existence in the formless realm, and for those passing away from the non-percipient beings—neither the material aggregate nor the feeling aggregate arises there. Or, conversely:
for whomsoever the feeling aggregate will not arise in a certain place, does the material aggregate not arise for them in that same place?
For those attaining rebirth in the five-aggregate realm and for those attaining rebirth among the non-percipient beings,
the aggregate of feeling will not arise there, yet the aggregate of form does not fail to arise for them there.
For those attaining final Nibbāna in the five-aggregate realm, for those in their final existence in the immaterial realm, and for those passing away from the non-percipient beings...
In that case, the aggregate of feeling will not arise and the aggregate of form does not arise.
For whomsoever, wherever the aggregate of feeling does not arise, for them there, will the aggregate of perception not arise?

For those passing away from the four-constituent or five-constituent realms, the aggregate of feeling does not arise there; yet it is not the case that for them [the aggregate of perception will not arise].

In that case, the aggregate of perception will not arise. For those attaining final Nibbāna and for non-percipient beings, neither the aggregate of feeling nor the aggregate of perception arises there. Or conversely:
for whomsoever the aggregate of perception will not arise in a certain place, does the aggregate of feeling not arise for them in that same place?
For those destined for their final existence who are being reborn, the aggregate of perception will not arise there,
but the aggregate of feeling does not fail to arise for them there. For those attaining final Nibbāna and for non-percipient beings,
neither the aggregate of perception nor the aggregate of feeling arises there.
2.2.1.6. Section on the Past and Future (Atītānāgatavāra) 2.2.1.6.1.
Positive Person (Anulomapuggala) For whom the aggregate of form (rūpakkhandha) has arisen, will the aggregate of feeling (vedanākkhandha) arise for that person?

For those in their final existence (*pacchimabhavika*), the aggregate of form (*rūpakkhandha*) had arisen, but the aggregate of feeling (*vedanākkhandha*) will not arise for them. For others, both the aggregate of form and the aggregate of feeling had arisen and will arise.
Or rather, for whomsoever the aggregate of feeling will arise, had the aggregate of form arisen for that person? Yes.
For whomsoever the aggregate of feeling had arisen, will the aggregate of perception (*saññākkhandha*) arise for that person?

For those in their final existence (*pacchimabhavika*), the aggregate of feeling (*vedanākkhandha*) had arisen, but the aggregate of perception (*saññākkhandha*) will not arise for them. For others, both the aggregate of feeling had arisen and the aggregate of perception will arise.
Or rather, for whomsoever the aggregate of perception will arise, had the aggregate of feeling arisen for them? Yes, it had.
2.2.1.6.2. Positive Plane (Anuloma-okāsa)
Where the aggregate of form (rūpakkhandha) has arisen, will the aggregate of feeling (vedanākkhandha) arise there?

In the case of non-percipient beings (asaññasatta), the aggregate of form has arisen there, but the aggregate of feeling will not arise there. In the five-aggregate realm (pañcavokāra), both the aggregate of form and the aggregate of feeling have arisen and will arise there.
Or conversely, where the aggregate of feeling will arise, has the aggregate of form arisen there?

In the immaterial plane, the aggregate of feeling will arise there, but the aggregate of form did not arise there. In the five-aggregate plane, both the aggregate of feeling will arise there and the aggregate of form arose there.
Wherever the aggregate of feeling arose, will the aggregate of perception arise there? Yes.
Or, wherever the aggregate of perception will arise, did the aggregate of feeling arise there? Yes.
2.2.1.6.3. Positive Person-Space (Anulomapuggalokāsa) For whom, in what place, did the aggregate of form arise, will the aggregate of feeling arise for them in that same place?
For those final-existence beings in the five-aggregate realm and for non-percipient beings, the aggregate of form arose in that place.

And for them, the aggregate of feeling will not arise there. For others belonging to the five-aggregate realm, both the aggregate of form and the aggregate of feeling have arisen there and will also arise there.
Or rather, for whomsoever the aggregate of feeling will arise there, has the aggregate of form arisen there for that person?
For those immaterial beings, the aggregate of feeling will arise there, but the aggregate of form has not arisen there for them.
For those five-aggregate beings, both the aggregate of feeling and the aggregate of form will arise there, and the aggregate of form has also arisen there for them.
For whomsoever the aggregate of feeling has arisen there, will the aggregate of perception arise there for that person?
For those in their final existence, the aggregate of feeling had arisen there,
but the aggregate of perception will not arise for them there. For others— those belonging to the four-constituent and five-constituent realms—
both the aggregate of feeling and the aggregate of perception had arisen and will also arise there.
Or, for whomsoever the aggregate of perception will arise at a certain place, has the aggregate of feeling arisen for that person at that place? Yes.
2.2.1.6.4. Negative Person:
For whom the aggregate of material form did not arise, will the aggregate of feeling not arise for that person? There is no such case.
Or, for whom the aggregate of feeling will not arise, had the aggregate of form not arisen for them? It had arisen.
For whom the aggregate of feeling had not arisen, will the aggregate of perception not arise for them? There is none.
Or, for whom the aggregate of perception will not arise, had the aggregate of feeling not arisen for them? It had arisen.
2.2.1.6.5. Negative Plane (Paccanīka-okāsa) Where the aggregate of form (rūpakkhandha) had not arisen, will the aggregate of feeling (vedanākkhandha) not arise there? It will arise.
Or else, where the aggregate of feeling will not arise, had the aggregate of form not arisen there? It had arisen.
Where the aggregate of feeling has not arisen, will the aggregate of perception not arise there? Yes.
Or, where the aggregate of perception will not arise, has the aggregate of feeling not arisen there? Yes.
2.2.1.6.6. Negative Person-Space (Paccanīka-Puggalokāsa).
For whom the aggregate of form has not arisen at a certain place, will the aggregate of feeling not arise for them at that place?
For those non-material beings (arūpa), the aggregate of form has not arisen there, but it is not the case that the aggregate of feeling will not arise for them there.
For those in the Pure Abodes (suddhāvāsa) and for those in their final existence in the immaterial realm (arūpa), the aggregate of form...
The aggregate of feeling had not arisen and will not arise.
Or, for whomsoever the aggregate of feeling will not arise at a certain place, had the aggregate of form not arisen for them at that place?
For those who are final-existence beings in the five-aggregate realm and for non-percipient beings, the aggregate of feeling will not arise at that place.

And for them, the aggregate of form did not arise there. For those in the Pure Abodes (Suddhāvāsa) who are in their final existence in the formless realm, neither will the aggregate of feeling arise there nor did the aggregate of form arise there.
For whomsoever the aggregate of feeling did not arise in a certain place, will the aggregate of perception not arise for them in that same place? Yes.
Or, for whomsoever the aggregate of perception will not arise at a certain place, has the aggregate of feeling not arisen for them there?
For those in their final existence, the aggregate of perception will not arise there, yet the aggregate of feeling has not failed to arise for them there.
For those in the Pure Abodes and for non-percipient beings, neither the aggregate of perception nor [the aggregate of feeling] will arise there.
And the aggregate of feeling did not arise.
The section on arising is finished.
